description: Client-side script for POS Invoice in ERPNext, defining POSInvoiceController class, event handlers, and UI interactions for POS invoices.

classes.name: POSInvoiceController
classes.description: Controller class for POS Invoice, extending SellingController with methods for POS-specific logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for POS invoice, including posting date/time check.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Handles actions on form load, including setting ignore_doctypes and triggering POS setup.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form, adds buttons, and handles return invoice setup.

methods.name: set_pos_data
methods.description: Fetches and sets POS-specific data, including print format and campaign.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Fetches customer party details and applies pricing rules.

methods.name: change_amount
methods.description: Calculates change amount and refreshes fields.

methods.name: loyalty_amount
methods.description: Calculates loyalty amount and refreshes related fields.

methods.name: write_off_outstanding_amount_automatically
methods.description: Automatically writes off outstanding amount if enabled.

methods.name: make_sales_return
methods.description: Creates a sales return document from current invoice.
